core_obligations: Show a derivation gives a map out of the differentials: assemble the rule into a map from the free module on the symbols and check that the derivation conditions say exactly that the relations are annihilated (proof lines 34091-34096).
Conclude the stated isomorphism of functors from that computation (proof lines 34095-34096).
proof_roadmap: Turn a derivation into a map on the free module (proof lines 34090-34093).
Verify the relations are killed and read off the isomorphism (proof lines 34093-34097).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that maps from the module of differentials into a module are the same as derivations, as an isomorphism of functors (statement lines 34072-34088, with the slogan that maps out of the differentials are derivations). The proof does not construct an inverse: it assembles a derivation into a map on the free module on the symbols and observes that the derivation conditions mean exactly that this map annihilates the relations defining the module of differentials (proof lines 34090-34097). Identifying the two sets of conditions is what proves the universal property. H2.
